newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares slip amid political uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares slip amid political uncertainty.

text.p: Delhi share prices closed lower in volatile trade on Thursday as major players stayed on the sidelines due to an uncertain political situation while speculators booked profits, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index ended 8.35 points lower at 936.95.
"The market has turned highly risky at this level mainly due to prevailing uncertainty on the political front in view of the split in the Janata Dal," said S.C. Juneja of brokers Jaico Credit.

Bihar state chief minister Laloo Prasad Yadav, leader of Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral's Janata Dal party, formed a breakaway group last Saturday, but immediately pledged to continue support to Gujral's coalition, saying he had nothing against the prime minister.
But pressure is mounting on Gujral from colleagues in his Janata Dal (JD) party and leftist allies in his 15-party United Front to kick out the breakaway group.
One broker said the buyers were shifting their focus from blue chip companies to low-priced growth companies.
Reliance Industries closed 0.60 rupee lower at 365.40.
Hindustan Lever bucked the trend to gain 3.25 rupees to 1,395.00, brokers said.
